
{{alias}}( arrays )
    Computes the arithmetic mean of an ndarray using the improved Kahan–Babuška algorithm.

    If provided an empty ndarray, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arrays: ArrayLikeObject<ndarray>
        Array-like object containing a single input ndarray.

    Returns
    -------
    out: number
        Arithmetic mean.

    Examples
    --------
    > var xbuf = [ 1.0, -2.0, 2.0 ];
    > var dt = 'generic';
    > var sh = [ xbuf.length ];
    > var sx = [ 1 ];
    > var ox = 0;
    > var ord = 'row-major';
    > var x = new {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/ctor}}( dt, xbuf, sh, sx, ox, ord );
    > {{alias}}( [ x ] )
    ~0.3333

    See Also
    --------
    {{alias:@stdlib/stats/base/ndarray/mean}}
    {{alias:@stdlib/stats/strided/meankbn}}
